question.prompt: Given \(a\parallel b\) and \(\angle 1=110^\circ\), what is the measure of its same-side interior angle \(\angle 2\), in degrees? (Lines \(a\) and \(b\) are cut by a third line; unit: degrees; enter only the numerical value.)

solutions.explanation: When two lines are parallel, same-side interior angles are supplementary, so \(\angle 2=180^\circ-110^\circ=70^\circ\).
solutions.title: Supplementary same-side interior angles
